title: M5 stage23: exact polynomial signature indicator
scope: Exact polynomial exclusion sum indexed by finite subsets of residual irreducible factors. Squarefree divisor reindexing and C/A assembly remain separate.

spec.name: M5.PolynomialIndicator.residual_factors_regular
spec.statement: ∀ (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (N : ℕ), 0 < N → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → ∀ p ∈ M5.PolynomialExclusion.residualFactors (M5.cyclicModulus N) F, p.Monic ∧ Irreducible p
spec.guidance: Use accepted M5.PolynomialExclusion.cyclic_quotient_nonzero and normalizedFactors membership irreducibility; M5.Signature.binary_monic makes every nonzero binary polynomial monic. Fully qualify imported theorem names. Return tactic lines without leading by; do not change target.

spec.name: M5.PolynomialIndicator.conditional_indicator
spec.statement: ∀ (a b F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (N : ℕ), 0 < N → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → F ∣ a → F ∣ b → M5.PolynomialIndicator.factorExclusionSum a b F N = (if M5.completeSignature a b N = F then 1 else 0)
spec.guidance: Instantiate M5.FiniteExclusion.exclusion_indicator at residual factors and bad p := decide (F*p ∣ a ∧ F*p ∣ b). For each subset, use M5.FactorProduct.product_event_iff for both a and b. Subset regularity comes from residual_factors_regular. Then use M5.PolynomialExclusion.finite_factor_criterion. FiniteExclusion.exclusionSum and factorExclusionSum are definitions. Use classical. Preserve multiplicities in F*p. Return tactic lines without leading by; do not change target.

spec.name: M5.PolynomialIndicator.exact_signature_indicator
spec.statement: ∀ (a b F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (N : ℕ), 0 < N → F.Monic → F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N → M5.PolynomialIndicator.factorExclusionSum a b F N = (if M5.completeSignature a b N = F then 1 else 0)
spec.guidance: Split F∣a and F∣b. If both hold apply conditional_indicator. Otherwise each summand vanishes because F divides F*product, and equality completeSignature=F would imply F divides both a,b by Euclidean gcd divisibility. No extra premise excluding zero a or b. Return tactic lines without leading by; do not change target.
